analogy.rationale: P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) inhibitors block an efflux transporter that is poorly expressed in most of these cell lines and do not directly perturb transcription, so they should elicit little or no transcriptional response. The closest analogs are other transporter/channel or xenobiotic-handling classes that similarly lack a strong downstream transcriptional program in these cells.
